ratified_by: USER (explicit instruction: '적극 헤지안 채택' + refinement: take first profit reliably, do not be only pessimistic, short-term rebounds happen)
amends: P6-07 private config/three_market_hedge/policy.json for PAPER: adds STANDALONE defensive inverse allocation that does not require held long exposure. P6-07 held-long hedge (RISK_OFF 25%-50% of held long exposure) remains.
framing: Defensive allocation (Cash/Reduce/Hedge/Inverse layer). Not a short-alpha engine. Performance tracked separately as hedge sleeve.

instruments.CRYPTO: cash; BTC perp short <=5% NAV only as stage-2 option after event study and a known crypto regime

allocation_caps_nav.RISK_OFF: P6-07 held-long hedge only (25%-50% of held long exposure)

entry.trigger: market STRESS confirmed 1 session (market regime KNOWN; UNKNOWN never triggers)
entry.pace: one third of the cap per session
entry.no_chase: skip a tranche when the inverse instrument already moved >= +3% from the prior session close

exit_staged_take_profit.initial_stop: position -4% from average entry -> exit that market's inverse
exit_staged_take_profit.TP1: position +3% -> sell 50% (first take-profit priority); move stop on remainder to breakeven
exit_staged_take_profit.rebound_guard: while in profit and before TP1: if underlying index rebounds >= +1.5% intraday/close (inverse <= -1.5% day), execute TP1 immediately
exit_staged_take_profit.runner: last 25% trailing stop 3% from peak position value
exit_staged_take_profit.regime_exits: market back to RISK_OFF -> reduce remaining inverse by 50%; NEUTRAL or better -> exit all
exit_staged_take_profit.time_stop: 10 sessions max holding; extension only if STRESS re-confirmed

re_entry: after TP1, if STRESS persists and underlying makes a new low, re-enter up to the sold quantity once per episode, within caps

validation.required: event study on KR/US STRESS episodes: n, TP1 touch rate vs SL first-touch rate, MFE/MAE, cost 2x, recent vs full period; one controlled parameter revision allowed
validation.portal: 04 portfolio + 05 performance show hedge sleeve separately (TP1 hit rate, stop rate, drawdown reduction)

known_blockers: US and Crypto market regime currently UNKNOWN -> rule inactive there until regime is KNOWN
KR regime must be KNOWN and confirmed
future_note: User principle 'first take-profit matters, rebounds happen' to be considered for the long-side Exit layer design (separate decision).
